capability.method: Bonferroni simultaneous Clopper-Pearson loss/gain bounds, confidence >=95%
capability.scope: prospectively declared repeated-pool capability monitor, selected32 MLP alpha1

limitations: v1/v2/v3无现实参考卡的校准失败；v4的通过只属于有参考来源仲裁，不属于闭卷知识记忆。
主行为是完整贪心生成整数；DLA和图谱输出预测仅下一token（首位数字），两者分开。
未见组合是熟悉实体的新虚构值和新句式；新实体仅测模型行为，未宣称图谱知识泛化。
预测器是条件统计代理，不是所有边都经参数/因果闭合的完整机制图。
系统指令先于正文，不沿用P2793的早位置未来线索不可见负对照。
背景为作者受控重复篇章，长度增加伴随内容增加。
32单元按答案首位贡献选择；可能涉及数字/格式而不是范围选择，未证明单个单元必要或语义单一。
能力检验为旧题池新操作重测、医学占比较高；140参考题不入门。
仅一物理节点和一个模型；无跨模型与独立节点复算。
未完成自然长语料神经元全体语义普查，本轮不是Goodfire全部结果复现。
强外部来源规则基线是看到主分析后增加的审查；其训练只用发现集，但比较属于事后审查，不改主判、不冒充新的确认测试。

mlp_plan.detail: Qwen3-4B共36×9728=350,208个原生MLP单元。先分层普查和分组解释，保留SAE/transcoder作同预算对照；不把“原生一定干净”或“一单元一概念”作为结论。已有GF-L30-U9517/U80使用256token窗口且未通过项目全部判据，不能算本轮长文本复现。
mlp_plan.title: 原生单元优先，作为研究主线

mlp_plan.detail: 按独立文档划分发现/确认/锁箱；512–2048token多领域长文采集G、V、A=SiLU(G)×V及写出。记录正负两极、G/V四象限、范数/RMS、弱响应、频率、近零与背景。原生全阵列不截断；Top例子仅作检索。先估计稀有强响应率，再按每极有效事件和独立文档数分配语料预算，不假定2Mtoken足够。
mlp_plan.title: 自然长语料两极、弱响应与门控分解

mlp_plan.detail: 从自然上下文提出单元功能假设；AI可写标签但不能自动升级证据。冻结新句式、新实体、包含关键词但不满足功能的近似反例，以及不含关键词的语义正例；独立划分检验两极和读入/写出。未知、粗粒度、多用途和无法复现都合法保留。
mlp_plan.title: 解释必须能预测新例与近似反例

mlp_plan.detail: 区分gate/up读取、down写出、残差/RMS、Attention提供的信息和后续神经元的读入。读写方向不必相同，不把它们不平行单独当作失败。沿参数乘积和实际响应构建类型化边，再用剂量、同层/同能量随机对照与交互消融检验作用。
mlp_plan.title: 从读入走到真实写出和上下游

mlp_plan.detail: 先以可解释且可重复的小型MLP子图为交付，不承诺先破解全部MLP。比较native与同k字典的激活预测、完整词表KL/损失恢复和未解释残差；预测时不能读取目标真值状态。持续做能力保持和生成保义检查，向Attention/残差追踪缺失来源，最后顺序跨模型与独立节点复算。
mlp_plan.title: 用预测保真度和能力保持验收

native.scope: all37 hidden layers/all36 blocks complete readout fields; deep8 full-token prefix; current-token cached generation traces

numeric_control.limit: additional descriptive control, no primary promotion; length may differ by1token

predictor.input_contract: only cached discovery-reality distributions for64 familiar entities, parsed document first digit, scope; both reference values explicitly in input; no heldout forward/state/logit in prediction
predictor.limits: empirical full-vocabulary next-token mixture, not a complete mechanistic graph or full-integer completion predictor

H2.criterion: on64 familiar entities,F2,1024,bothscopes; joint32 MLP activation removal reduces full-integer accuracy>=.20; loss versus same-block/RMS-matched random32>=.10 and entity bootstrap95% lower>0; behavior gate required

preregistration.behavior_gate: full greedy generated integer equals the complete number, max4 new tokens; each unseen-combination and unseen-entity scope accuracy>=.80; do not discard individual errors

calibration.scope: only16 discovery entities,F0/F1; previous v1/v2/v3 failures retained

preregistration.capability: unconditionally run new32-MLP alpha1 onthe repeated frozen2200 keyed pool,2pp NI andpaired simultaneousCP95%;140reference-only excluded
preregistration.interventions: multiply selected final-query activations by1-alpha at every actual generated step; head8 andsame-blockrandom8 secondary; originalweights unchanged
limits: only one attribute andone localphysical node
scope is system-level; changes early states too
world reference is supplied, not memory-only arbitration
single final query pathway andfirstdigit DLA selection
preregistration.native: all37 hidden layers and36 blocks complete G/V/A,HeadZ at entity/final; deep8 fulltoken HiddenState/QKV, actual cached generation steps; raw values notTopK

prediction.criterion: >=10% KL reduction versus scope-blind mixture, entity cluster bootstrap lower of KL gain>0, behavior gate required
prediction.internal: discovery-selected block; Ridge lambda1, entity-by-scope and each explicitly provided source-first-digit-by-scope one-hots; predict all9728 MLP units and2560 next hidden coordinates; compare entity/scope empiricalmean, report raw/standardizedMSE
prediction.internal_criterion: >=5% standardizedMSE reduction and paired entity bootstrap lower>0; no test-state/logit or expected answer label as input; source values are explicitly present in user text
prediction.limit: familiar-entity new combinations; no graph-only new-entity prediction claim, no complete-integer generation prediction claim
prediction.output: full-vocabulary NEXT token KL on256 unseen-combination inputs; mixture of discovery reality-memory nodes and document-first-digit prototypes, scope weights fit ondiscovery only; cached model not called at prediction time
prediction.status: predeclared heldout predictive assessment, no assumed power for continuous KL/MSE

preregistration.scope: single-entity atomic-number arbitration with an explicit verified reference card AND a contradictory fictitious record in both scopes; NOT closed-book factual recall
preregistration.selection: discovery only; select32 native MLP units and8heads in blocks18..35 by mean direct expected-first-digit minus opposing-first-digit contribution; actual final RMS fixed. This selects answer-support candidates, NOT scope-specific semantic units.

splits.discovery: 64 familiar entities x2 frames x2 scopes,1024tokens,256inputs
splits.unseen_combination: same64 entities,new number assignments andnew source frames2/3,256inputs

selection.selected_only: discovery final-query direct first-token contributions; not a scope-specific or causal neuron label

strong_baselines.definition: deterministic external source-selection rule + discovery-only first-digit output/native prototypes; parses values explicitly printed in input
strong_baselines.status: posthoc stronger-baseline audit; no threshold reselection or primary promotion
